observations.finding: At full-page scale the fig-177 focal dots and the left fig-178 dot appeared filled. The separately opened source-identical RAW pixels show small white centers in both focal markers of each figure. The right fig-178 marker has a particularly clear diamond-like white center. The original SVG previews preserve these source-ink details.
observations.source_binding_basis: Exact decoded-pixel equality of each RAW interior to the corresponding source-page box, demonstrated by the command evidence below; not an assumption that candidate pixels are correct.
